title: Rangka theme
description: Layer 6: colours, type and density for an installation or one organisation. Starts from a template (extends) and overrides tokens. Light and dark are always both produced; overriding one colour derives its dark pair unless given.

extends.description: Template, e.g. rangka/standard, rangka/laut, rangka/daun, rangka/senja, rangka/anggur, rangka/arang (rangka/clinic and rangka/retail are old names of daun and senja)

accent.description: One business colour; the kernel derives brand, selection, link, focus, chart-1 and their dark values, always passing the contrast floors (contract 0065 §1-2)

button.description: Primary buttons stay ink, or take the accent (contract 0065 §1)

neutral.description: Neutral family: warm stone (tokens.json), cool slate, or plain gray (contract 0065 §1)

color.description: Token overrides by token name (primary, selected, brand, chart-1…). A string sets light and derives dark; an object sets both. Applied after neutral and accent. Status colours (ok, warn, bad, info, discovery and their variants), raka*, spark, helmet, scrim and mascot-ink are locked (contract 0065 §1).

font.description: font.sans and font.display: one of the bundled fonts system, inter, plus-jakarta-sans, nunito-sans, ibm-plex-sans, source-serif-4 (contract 0065 §5)

contrast_check.description: Refuse overrides that drop text below 4.5:1 or controls below 3:1
